Synchronize Shoplinker Product Inventory

API for registering and updating Shoplinker product inventory. (Inventory is not synchronized to mall products.)

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/Stock.php?iteminfo_url=XML URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required partner_product_id string Customer product code (product management code)
3. stock_gubun string Required option type Optional
  1. - Update by code: 001
  2. - Update by adding new options or after resetting: 002
 - When updating optionsRequired input value.
- When updating by code: only quantity and price are applied
- When adding new options or after resetting: delete all options before applying changes
4. add_stock_gubun string Additional option type Optional
  1. - Update by code: 001
  2. - Update by adding new options or after resetting: 002
 - When updating optionsRequired input value.
- When updating by code: only quantity and price are applied
- When adding new options or after resetting: delete all options before applying changes
5. prod_stock_flag string Whether inventory management is enabled Optional
  1. - Inventory management enabled: 001
  2. - Inventory management disabled: 002
 Default value: 002
stock_row string Repeated row tag for required options - When updating required options Required input value.
6. stock_name string Option title - When updating required optionsRequired input value.
Separate combined options with /. Example: Color/Size
7. stock_value string Option value - When updating required optionsRequired input value.
Separate combined option values with /. Example: Black/95
8. stock_quantity integer Option quantity - When updating required options Required input value.
9. stock_sale_price integer Option additional price
10. stock_supply_price integer Option supply price
11. stock_keyword string Option keywords
12. stock_partner_code string Option management code
13. stock_barcode string Option barcode
14. stock_supplier string Option supplier
15. stock_safety integer Option safety stock
16. sale_status string Sale status Optional
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sold out : 004
  4. - Delete : 005
  5. - Sales ended : 006
17. market_price integer Marketplace list price
18. sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
19. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price
20. quantity integer Product quantity

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Optional
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>;
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P012545</product_id>
		<message>수정성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
